No teaching moment

A first step with no second step

Someone who connects with a reel about their father or mother can join your $12 challenge, but when the 12 days end there is no next offer linked to take them deeper. Most people need a clear path once they've felt the work.

No qualifier

Your best fits look like everyone else

The entrepreneurs who are ready to invest in deeper work with you scroll past the same posts as everyone else. Nothing asks them to raise their hand.

No list engine

Growth depends on today's post

With nothing evergreen capturing buyers every day, new buyers only appear when a post or a challenge launch lands, and quiet weeks show up in your diary.

The people who feel seen by your posts but aren't ready for deeper work today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"It started before your business did"

Hook
"Most money patterns weren't learned in a business course. They were learned at the kitchen table." (to camera, close framing)
Body
"What you saw growing up about earning, spending and being allowed to want more often shows up years later in how you price, how you receive and what you keep. You can't think your way out of something your body learned first. That's why I teach an embodiment practice alongside the insight." (slow push-in)
CTA
"I'm teaching it in a live 60-minute masterclass called Hold More. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Try this with me"

Hook
"Next time a payment lands, notice what your body does. Try this with me for 20 seconds." (Renée places a hand on her chest)
Body
"Breathe in slowly. Picture money arriving. Notice: does your chest open or tighten? Do you want to spend it straight away? That reaction is information, and it often has a story behind it." (on-screen captions for each step)
CTA
"In my masterclass, Hold More, we go through the full practice together. $17, live, with a replay. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"200+ clients, one common thread"

Hook
"I've worked with 200+ clients in 17 countries, and one thread comes up again and again." (walking, natural light)
Body
"Smart, driven people who know exactly what to do with money, and still find it slipping away. When we look closer, there's often a pattern from their father or their mother underneath. Once you can feel it, you can start to work with it."
CTA
"I'm opening that up in a live class called Hold More. 60 minutes, $17, replay included. Tap Sign up."
